scripts.db:test:prepare: npm run db:test:reset && npm run db:test:items && npm run db:test:fixtures
scripts.test:api: npm run test:module1 && npm run test:module2
scripts.test:report:smoke: newman run postman/IMS-Smoke.postman_collection.json -e postman/IMS.local.postman_environment.json -r cli,json,htmlextra --reporter-json-export test-results/smoke.json --reporter-htmlextra-export test-results/smoke.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "IMS Smoke Test"
scripts.test:report:module1: newman run postman/IMS-Module-1-Intake-Approval.postman_collection.json -e postman/IMS.local.postman_environment.json -r cli,json,htmlextra --reporter-json-export test-results/module-1.json --reporter-htmlextra-export test-results/module-1.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "IMS Module 1 — Intake & Approval"
scripts.test:report:module2: newman run postman/IMS-Module-2-Sales-Stock-Reports.postman_collection.json -e postman/IMS.local.postman_environment.json -r cli,json,htmlextra --reporter-json-export test-results/module-2.json --reporter-htmlextra-export test-results/module-2.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "IMS Module 2 — Sales, Stock & Reports"
scripts.test:report: npm run test:report:smoke && npm run test:report:module1 && npm run test:report:module2
scripts.test:flow: npm run db:test:prepare && npm run build:test && npm run test:ci
